work.text: Hiroshige created many different print series on the Tokaidō, a road that ran from Kyoto to Edo (now Tokyo).

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art
source.title: Driving Rain at Shōno, from Fifty-Three Stations of the Tokaidō

moment.text: Returning to Edo, Hiroshige immediately launched on his monumental project of publishing the Fifty-three Stations of the Tokaido Road.

matters.text: Utagawa Hiroshige’s design for this print captures the atmospheric qualities of rain and its effects on two groups of travelers.
